_comment: Tier-2 for febio::hyperelasticity#2. Under DYNAMIC, a neo-Hookean cube with <density> OMITTED gives results BIT-IDENTICAL to <density>1.0</density> — which is how the silent default is established rather than assumed — while <density>1000.0</density> differs by a large relative margin and <density>0.0</density> reproduces the STATIC answer bit for bit. All five runs reach normal termination with exit 0 and no warning, so nothing in the log distinguishes them. The bit-identity assertions are what make this fixture informative; a mere "it differs" check would pass on noise. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
